fields.title: Ecommerce platform market-share record
fields.description: Every record carries _input, _source, _scrapedAt and recordType. recordType discriminates the payload: PLATFORM (headline stats), GROWTH (one quarter of the store-count series), BREAKDOWN (stores by country/app/technology/...), MIGRATION (stores switching between platforms), STORE (a store published in the report's top/new lists), AVAILABLE_REPORT (reference mode) and ERROR. Counts are parsed to integers, with the published row kept under _raw.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The platform slug that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: PLATFORM | GROWTH | BREAKDOWN | MIGRATION | STORE | AVAILABLE_REPORT | ERROR.

reportUrl.title: Report URL
reportUrl.description: Public report page this record came from.

reportUpdated.title: Report updated
reportUpdated.description: Date the publisher last updated the report, YYYY-MM-DD.

liveStores.title: Live stores
liveStores.description: How many live stores run on the platform right now.

quarterOverQuarterQuarter.title: QoQ quarter
quarterOverQuarterQuarter.description: Which quarter the QoQ figure refers to.

yearOverYearQuarter.title: YoY quarter
yearOverYearQuarter.description: Which quarter the YoY figure refers to.

latestQuarter.title: Latest quarter
latestQuarter.description: Most recent quarter in the growth series.

latestQuarterIsPartial.title: Latest quarter is partial
latestQuarterIsPartial.description: True when the newest quarter is still in progress - do not read it as a decline.

latestQuarterStores.title: Latest quarter stores
latestQuarterStores.description: Store count for the most recent quarter.

quartersOfHistory.title: Quarters of history
quartersOfHistory.description: How many quarters the growth series covers.

sectionsFound.title: Sections found
sectionsFound.description: Which report sections carried data for this platform. Small platforms publish fewer.

quarter.title: Quarter
quarter.description: Calendar quarter of a growth row, e.g. '2026 Q2'.

activeStores.title: Active stores
activeStores.description: Live store count for that quarter.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: country | category | app | technology | theme | tld | shipping-carrier | employee-count | product-count | social-media | contact-info.

label.title: Label
label.description: The value within that dimension, e.g. 'United States' or 'Judge.me Product Reviews App'.

code.title: Code
code.description: Machine code for the label where the report publishes one, e.g. 'US' for United States.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: How many stores fall into this bucket.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: switched-in (stores that moved to this platform) or switched-out (stores that left it).

otherPlatform.title: Other platform
otherPlatform.description: The platform stores moved from or to.

listType.title: List type
listType.description: top (highest-ranked stores) or new (recently created stores).

name.title: Store name
name.description: Store name as published in the report.

url.title: Store URL
url.description: https:// URL built from the domain.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: Traffic rank the report publishes for the store - lower is bigger.

created.title: Created
created.description: When the store was first seen, as published.

_raw.title: Raw published row
_raw.description: The report's own row, exactly as published.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type.

marketShare.title: Market share
marketShare.description: One row per platform - sort by live stores to rank the market.

growth.title: Growth series
growth.description: Quarterly store counts, ready to chart.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Top and newest stores published per platform.
